label: Binomial Theorem
subgoals: Read row n of Pascal's triangle as expansion coefficients
Pair each coefficient with one a^(n-k) b^k term
Count n+1 terms in the full expansion

label: Statement
subgoals: Run a's exponent down from n to 0
Match C(n,k) against C(n,n-k) for symmetry

label: Binomial coefficient
subgoals: Compute C(n,k) as n! over k!(n-k)!
Zero out C(n,k) when n < k
Count unordered k-choices from n elements
